props.title: Millcreek 3D buildings from LiDAR outlines (2023 lidar), planning estimate
props.snippet: Unvalidated planning estimate: 3D buildings outlined and modelled from the 2023 lidar (roofer LoD 2.2), county footprints only where trees hide a roof. Heights and areas in metres and feet.
props.description:
23,593 buildings: 23,373 outlined from the 2023 lidar itself and modelled with roofer LoD 2.2, and 220 county footprints whose roofs the lidar cannot see under trees (their October 25 models). OUTLINE_SOURCE says which; COMPARE_CLASS and COUNTY_IDS say how each lidar outline compares with the county footprints.

Every metric field has a feet twin beside it in the same layer: _FT for lengths and heights, _SQFT for areas, _CUFT for volume (international foot). Lidar outlines follow the roof edge, a median 0.39 m (1.3 ft) outside the county wall lines. Heights NAVD88.

Replaces the three-way hybrid on county footprints (ce3617ac9b884bbcbee7c47a3e166999), which is kept for rollback.
props.accessInformation: City of Millcreek GIS. Lidar: 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (USGS 3DEP, project UT_2023SaltLakeCo_C24). Building outlines: from the lidar; county footprints (Salt Lake County Assessor and Surveyor, downloaded October 19, 2026) only where trees hide a roof. Roof models: roofer 1.0.0 (3DGI / TU Delft).
props.licenseInfo:
These data are unvalidated planning estimates produced by City of Millcreek GIS from 2023 lidar. They are not surveyed, engineered or field-verified, and must not be used to determine property boundaries or ownership, building or site design, engineering, flood or drainage design, code compliance (including building height), or any legal or regulatory determination. They are provided as is, without warranty of accuracy, completeness or fitness for any purpose; check conditions on the ground before relying on them. Credit "City of Millcreek GIS; 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (USGS 3DEP)" when you use or show them.

Salt Lake County data. The building footprints and their County attributes come from Salt Lake County (Assessor and Surveyor). The County's own terms apply to them: the County states that its footprints are not field verified, are for general reference only, and are not intended to determine property ownership, final building and site design or jurisdictional boundaries, or to replace a certified topographical or boundary survey or any other legal document.
